nothing about marriage, spouses or consent

no mention of social security or the capacity in which it is held; 'community'/'society' appear only as the object of duties and as 'a democratic society'
nothing about work, remuneration, workers or families
no mention of rest, leisure, working hours or holidays

arbitrary interference, privacy, family, home and correspondence are absent
movement and residence are absent, but the generic clause on 'limitations as are determined by law' is adjacent to a question about limits on a right

no statement about government or the basis of its authority; 'democratic society' only qualifies the general welfare
nothing about remuneration, workers or dignity of existence
motherhood and childhood are not mentioned
torture and forms of treatment or punishment are absent
no mention of hearings, tribunals or equality before a court
no penal offences and no reference to national or international law; 'determined by law' concerns limitations only

answered by 'These rights and freedoms may in no case be exercised contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations.' - which supplies exactly the 'acts contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations' part of the sought answer about when a right may not be invoked
nationality is never mentioned
no mention of associations or of being compelled to belong to anything; the passage speaks only of duties to the community
no mention of national effort or international co-operation as means of realizing rights
pay, work and discrimination are absent
the passage lists no situations giving rise to a right to security; its only three-item list concerns morality, public order and general welfare
the passage does not discuss how the Declaration may be interpreted, though 'may in no case be exercised contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations' is adjacent in spirit
no list of things protected from arbitrary interference appears
asylum and persecution are not mentioned
marriage and spousal consent are not mentioned
no mention of taking part in government, directly or through representatives
rest, leisure, working hours and holidays are absent

penalties and their limits are not discussed

property and deprivation of property are not mentioned, nor is arbitrariness
